title: Special Executive Master Programme in Operations Management
description: SEMP in Operations Management provides executives with the tools and knowledge to streamline processes, optimize efficiency, and drive operational excellence within their organisations.
longDescription: The Special Executive Master Programme (SEMP) in Operations Management offers a comprehensive understanding of the principles and practices of streamlining business operations. It covers critical topics such as supply chain management, management information systems, quality control, project management, and operational strategy. The Programme offers an efficient approach beyond traditional classroom learning. The course emphasises real-world applications through case studies, business simulations, and 100% project-based learning, allowing participants to practice what they learn in a controlled environment before applying it to their roles. The Special Executive Master Programme in Operations Management allows you to achieve the qualification in 6 months. It is a fast track to new opportunities and enhanced career prospects. The program prepares learners to tackle complex operational challenges effectively by integrating theoretical knowledge with practical applications.
courseDetails: SEMP in Operations Management aims to equip learners with a comprehensive understanding of operational strategies, technologies, and management practices. This enables them to optimise efficiency, enhance decision-making, manage projects effectively, and drive operational excellence across supply chains and business processes. Course Details: Management Information System: This module explores using technology and data systems to streamline business operations and support decision-making processes. Operations Management: Focuses on the principles and practices of managing production and service operations, emphasising efficiency and quality. Planning, Controlling, and Leading a Project: Teaches the skills to effectively plan projects, monitor progress, and lead teams to achieve successful outcomes. Supply Chain Management: This course covers the end-to-end management of supply chains, from sourcing materials to delivering finished products, highlighting strategies to optimise efficiency and reduce costs. Operations and Information Management for Project Managers: Explores how information systems support operational workflows and project management, focusing on integrating technology to improve project outcomes. Advanced Research Methods: Introduces advanced techniques for conducting research in operations management. Assessment: GP Upon finishing the coursework, students must complete a graduation project(GP) that combines and utilises the knowledge acquired across different modules. This qualification embodies current practices in operations management and helps learners deepen and broaden their understanding of the field at an advanced level. Programme Structure and Credits: This programme comprises 6 modules with 30 ECTS and 1 GP of 30 ECTS.

modules.title: OPERATIONS MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: This course is an introduction to the concepts, principles, problems, and practices of operations management. Emphasis is on managerial processes for effective operations in both goods-producing and service-rendering organization. Topics include operations strategy, process design, capacity planning, facilities location and design, forecasting, production scheduling, inventory control, quality assurance, and project management. The topics are integrated using a systems model of the operations of an organization.

modules.title: SUPPLY CHAIN MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: The aim of the programme is to provide postgraduate-level education in operations and supply chain management principles, theories and practice. This unit introduces the concepts of logistics and supply chain management. In the modern global marketplace, companies need to be efficient in relation to the movement of supplies and delivery of the final products. The unit explores issues in relation to logistics including value, managing lead time and techniques including just-in-time, and incorporating the role of technology in this process.

lessons.title: Supply Chain Planning Models and Approaches

modules.title: OPERATIONS AND INFORMATION MANAGEMENT FOR PROJECT MANAGERS
modules.summary: This module examines how effective operations and information management contribute to successful project delivery. It focuses on aligning operational strategies with project objectives, ensuring efficient resource utilization and workflow optimization. Students will explore tools and systems used for information tracking, performance measurement, and decision-making. The module emphasizes the integration of data-driven insights to enhance productivity and manage project risks. By the end, learners will be equipped to streamline operations and leverage information systems for improved project outcomes.

modules.title: ADVANCED RESEARCH METHODS
modules.summary: The course is designed to help students become good researchers, to become familiar with the steps in proposing research topics, and clearly apply research knowledge in education. After completing the course, students will be able to prepare a research plan, collect data, address research questions and hypotheses, and organize a project report.
